findings.text: _linear_problem re-implements the affine Newton operand assembly owned by nova/biot/magnetisation.py:1055-1110 rather than calling an exported builder, so the refined reference can drift from the production solve if that assembly changes; the fragment records this as follow-up at :130 but the brief forbade touching nova/, so it is carried, not fixed.

the per-probe relative gap divides by np.linalg.norm(cholesky_field, axis=1) with no guard, so a probe where the Cholesky route's field is zero yields inf or nan; the maximum_entry path at :402 guards with 1e-300 but the per-probe path does not.

rejected = outcome != "rounding" counts an indeterminate outcome as a refused defect, so a perturbation that fell below the resolvability floor would record the control fitted/refused rather than untested; requiring outcome == "defect" would make the control's claim match its name.

resolvable is recomputed here and again inside _route_verdict at :371, so a future change to one expression would leave the receipt's reference.resolvable disagreeing with verdict.resolvable for the same numbers.

the fragment cites uniform-0.04.json, but job 1338337 never ran and that receipt still carries the discredited self-referential negative_control block (negative_control.detected: true), which the fragment now disowns; regenerating the receipt or citing the preserved uniform-0.04-job1338206.json name would stop a reader opening the artifact from seeing the old control.

item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for the residual and condition estimate, both routes' distances with the reference error at least a decade below, and a stated verdict; uniform-0.04.json records residual 4.3372e-16, condition 1.0186e8, LU 7.7697e-13/1.0863e-12, Cholesky 2.4026e-13/3.2889e-13, forward error 2.3889e-16 and outcome rounding, and the focused suite arms at logs/base-focused.log and logs/after-focused.log record 1 failed/12 passed each, EXIT=1 each, same id.
item_verdicts.goal: the source goal is an iteratively refined reference solve on the persisted uniform 40 mm operator with both routes' distances and a rounding-or-defect verdict; measure.py:306 route_refinement and the fragment at :88 deliver it, unchanged in substance by the five gained commits.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits list all eight, tests describe the focused arms and the H200 receipt, and it records the operator control as not yet measured (job 1338337 queued), matching the fragment.

justifications.durability: no test asserts the new defect control; the smoke driver run_defect_smoke.py only prints defect_rejected, so a regression that made _route_verdict return rounding would not fail anything.

justifications.fit: the new _route_verdict at measure.py:269 has a docstring and mechanism names with no plan label, matching the surrounding numpy/jnp style, though measure.py:388-399 adds an unguarded probe-scale division.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/iron-core-magnetisation/icm-route-refined-reference.html:89 states the rounding verdict on the persisted operator, and measure.py:306 route_refinement still reports the residual, condition estimate, both routes' distances and the verdict the goal names.
justifications.reuse: measure.py:111 _linear_problem still re-implements the affine Newton operand assembly owned by nova/biot/magnetisation.py:1055-1110 instead of calling an exported builder, documented as follow-up at fragment:130 but not resolved.
justifications.scope_discipline: the five gained commits touch only scripts/west_iron_linear/measure.py and docs/evidence/fragments/iron-core-magnetisation/icm-route-refined-reference.html, both inside the declared write paths.
